# Section

An opening paragraph, long enough to wrap, so the body style and its justification reach the output, with a footnote[^1] and a citation [@hebstr2026].

## Lists

1. A loose item, written with a blank line between items, long enough to wrap over more than one line so its size and its line spacing both reach the output.

2. A second loose item, which Pandoc writes as a paragraph carrying numbering and no style of its own.

- A tight item, which Pandoc writes as a `Compact` paragraph.
- A second tight item.

## Callouts

::: {.callout-note}
### A callout titled by a heading

Its body paragraph, which comes out as ordinary prose once the callout is flattened.
:::

::: {.callout-warning}
### A callout with no body at all
:::

::: {.callout-tip}
An untitled callout, whose content opens the flattened block with no bold paragraph above it.
:::

## Figures

```{r}
#| label: fig-bottom
#| fig-cap: "Bottom caption<br><span class='quarto-float-subcaption'>Subtitle line.</span>"
#| fig-height: 2

plot(1:3)
```

```{r}
#| label: fig-top
#| fig-cap: "Top caption."
#| fig-cap-location: top
#| fig-height: 2

plot(1:3)
```

```{r}
#| label: fig-panels
#| fig-cap: "Panel caption<br><span class='quarto-float-subcaption'>Panel subtitle.</span>"
#| fig-subcap:
#|   - "First panel."
#|   - "Second panel."
#| layout-nrow: 2
#| fig-height: 2

plot(1:3)
plot(2:4)
```

::: {layout-ncol=2}
```{r}
#| label: fig-left
#| fig-cap: "Left of a layout row."
#| fig-height: 2

plot(1:3)
```

```{r}
#| label: fig-right
#| fig-cap: "Right of a layout row."
#| fig-height: 2

plot(2:4)
```
:::

## Tables

::: {#tbl-md}
  | a   | b   |
  | --- | --- |
  | 1   | 2   |

A Markdown table caption.
:::

```{r}
#| label: tbl-gt
#| tbl-cap: "A gt table caption.<br><span class='quarto-float-subcaption'>Table subtitle.</span>"

gt::gt(head(mtcars[, 1:3], 3))
```

```{r}
#| label: tbl-anx-probe
#| tbl-cap: "An annexe caption."

knitr::kable(head(mtcars[, 1:2], 2))
```

Cross-references to @fig-bottom, @fig-top, @fig-panels, @fig-left, @fig-right, @tbl-md, @tbl-gt and @anx-probe.

[^1]: A footnote.
